Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Done. Here's what was built:

**New combined "Assets & Entities" tab** (`assets-entities.tsx`):

- **Single nav item** replaces the old "Assets" (shortcut 8) and "Entities" (shortcut 4) tabs — now lives at shortcut **4**
- **Shared narrative seed** at the top feeds into both asset image generation and Gamma prompts
- **View switcher** (Assets / Components & Entities) toggles between the two sections in the same tab
- **Gamma PDF generation** — every asset card and every entity row has a `Gamma` / `PDF` / `Doc` button that:
  - Opens a pre-built, editable prompt in a dialog
  - "Send to AI Chat" fires it into the ChatPanel so I (Claude) can call `mcp__claude_ai_Gamma__generate`
  - Deck entities get a richer prompt listing all child cards with names, subtypes, and descriptions
  - Non-deck entities get a component reference doc prompt
  - Assets get an asset reference PDF prompt
- **Inline editing on asset cards** — clicking Edit expands the card itself with all fields (name, kind, description, flavor text, linked entity) instead of the old top-panel form
- **Deck expand button** in the entity expanded view has an explicit "Generate PDF" shortcut button
- All existing functionality preserved: AI Enhance, image generation, entity properties, AI batch generate, duplicate, delete

To generate a Gamma PDF: click **Gamma** / **PDF** / **Doc** on any card → review the prompt → **Send to AI Chat** → open the chat and send.
